sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define 'Seed Germination' in the practical context of starting a school plant nursery. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Seed germination is the biological process where a dry seed absorbs water, sprouts a tiny root, and develops into a seedling under favorable moisture and temperature conditions.

questions.question_text: What is the main environmental purpose of creating a compost pit inside a School Habitat Garden? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A compost pit recycles organic waste like dry leaves and fruit peels into nutrient-rich natural fertilizer, which improves soil health and promotes robust plant growth sustainably.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain why fabric must be thoroughly washed and dried before starting a tie and dye activity. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Washing the fabric removes factory sizing, dirt, and natural oils. This ensures the textile fibers are completely clean and ready to absorb the colored dyes evenly and deeply.

questions.question_text: Your class is assigned a vocational project to convert an empty patch of school land into a butterfly habitat garden. Outline the practical steps you would take to design and prepare this outdoor space. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, survey the area to ensure it receives adequate sunlight. Next, clear out weeds and enrich the topsoil using organic compost. Finally, plant native nectar-rich flowers like marigolds, and place shallow water dishes to attract and sustain local butterflies.
